fixture_name: Express-collector corridor planning study — Canada TAC planning (Toronto context, PD-licensed portal)
subject: judge-baseline

justifications.substance: Simultaneous transfer-permission and signage changes at three interchanges on a 420,000 AADT express-collector mainline create a credible decision-load/erratic-maneuver mechanism squarely relevant to a Planning Stage RSA.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal 'collisions displaced elsewhere along the route' claim is anchored by the verbatim EV-CA-003 quote ('avoid introducing collisions elsewhere along the route or on the network') plus recorded inputs (AADT 420,000, three-interchange scope).
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly filed as a safety_concern under CRSAG audit objectives with no compliance/safety conflation; null normative_basis_note is appropriate for this category.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Staging one interchange per quarter with before/after speed-differential monitoring is specific, sequenced, measurable, and operationally viable for a transition-period mitigation.
justifications.vru_coverage: VRUs explicitly considered and ruled out with justification (controlled-access facility, no pedestrians/cyclists), matching the not-applicable-but-acknowledged case.

justifications.substance: Unresolved conflict between ministry and municipal continuity records leaves the planning-stage audit boundary unconfirmed, a genuine compliance/completeness risk since redistributed movements at interchanges outside the limits could escape audit.
justifications.evidence_grounding: Pivotal requirement and the Interchange 2 continuity deficiency are supported by the verbatim EV-CA-007 quote, and both sides of the conflict are recorded input facts rather than invented content.
justifications.jurisdiction_correctness: Correctly framed as a compliance_question about scope-record reconciliation under TAC CRSAG Section 5.3 semantics, kept categorically distinct from any asserted safety defect or collision mechanism.
justifications.recommendation_quality: Specific and actionable: names both conflicting records, the responsible actor (ministry planning office), and a concrete deliverable (recorded resolution of whether continuity effects stay inside the audit boundary).
justifications.vru_coverage: VRU relevance acknowledged—no pedestrians or cyclists on the controlled-access mainline, with downstream arterial propagation noted—but no VRU-specific exposure is analysed, fitting the not-applicable-but-acknowledged case.
